guidance.native_definition: Same trained Wan LoRA with all physical additions disabled

caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
positive_analysis:
1. Roller’s textured surface contacts metal fence, transferring green paint via physical adhesion.  
2. Paint flows continuously from roller to fence as it rolls, covering surface uniformly.  
3. Fence’s metal grid remains structurally intact while paint layer builds on its surface.  
4. If roller continues rolling, more fence area will become coated with green paint.
positive_relations: Roller’s textured surface contacts metal fence, transferring green paint via physical adhesion.
Paint flows continuously from roller to fence as it rolls, covering surface uniformly.
Fence’s metal grid remains structurally intact while paint layer builds on its surface.
If roller continues rolling, more fence area will become coated with green paint.
negative_analysis:
1. Roller’s textured surface contacts panel, transferring paint as it rolls.
2. Paint flows continuously from roller to panel surface during motion.
3. Panel’s grid structure remains fixed while roller moves across it.
4. Roller’s rotation persists as long as applied force maintains motion.
scope: Read only request-associated C with the same trained physical Q/K/V/O and state interaction
